verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe AI generating first drafts of postmortems, inline review suggestions, and redrafting sections (incident-io-docs-6), plus customizable timelines (docs-4/49), follow-ups tracked separately (docs-7/39/61), and AI summaries/suggestions drawing on incident activity (docs-11/12/53/54) — together covering timeline, contributing factors via investigations (docs-14/31), and follow-ups feeding into a human-reviewable draft. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account of the postmortem draft quality or explicit confirmation that 'contributing factors' section specifically is auto-populated, and no third-party review of the AI drafting feature itself.
